# Camp Resource: Rad-Pheasant Coop

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jul 24, 2024
- 1 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_880a771a538a476fa57757201e1f9c2d~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Add your very own Rad-Pheasant to your C.A.M.P. with the Rad-Pheasant Coop.

Generates fertilizer.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Rad-Pheasant Coop__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4796c05330fa4b919ad28aa63a2d1019~mv2.png)

Image Credit: __SugarBombsRADS__

**Produces**

Fertilizer

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Caged Rabbit, Chicken Coop, and Rad-Pheasant Coop.

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

10 Fertilizer

**Obtainable via**

Milepost Zero - X - X (TBA)

**Produces X amount per**

1 minute and 48 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

9 Flamingo Units

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)

Hi, I'm Kat or Duchess

I'm an Australian data miner who writes farming, event, and food buff guides for Fallout 76.
